pairs.decision: Retain as distinct neighbouring monuments; do not merge or move coordinates.
pairs.reason: The bathhouse and gateway have separate DOAM identities. WCLA describes the hammam beside Delhi Gate; AKDN identifies the conserved bathhouse in the Delhi Gate area. Close proximity is therefore expected, not evidence of a duplicated place.
pairs.scope: Identity/proximity review only. Source coordinates are retained, not claimed as a new survey.
